definitions.gloss: to assume, to suppose, to envision, to hypothesize
definitions.explanation: To consider a particular situation or scenario as a possibility, especially for planning or preparation purposes. Common in formal, technical, and disaster-preparedness contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最悪|さいあく}→最悪：13009_saiaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{想定|そうてい}する。
{想定|そうてい}して⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{想定|そうてい}した⟦{避難|ひなん}{訓練|くんれん}→避難訓練：28230_hinankunren⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An evacuation drill assuming an earthquake was carried out.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word frequently used in news, business, and official documents. The noun form ⟦{想定|そうてい}→想定：12623_soutei⟧ is also very common: ⟦{想定|そうてい}{外|がい}→想定外：17518_souteigai⟧ (beyond expectations) became widely known after the 2011 earthquake and nuclear disaster.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{想定|そうてい}{外|がい}→想定外：17518_souteigai⟧: beyond assumptions, unexpected
- ⟦{想定|そうてい}{内|ない}→想定内：19653_souteinai⟧: within expectations
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{想定|そうてい}した⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: drill assuming ~
- {想定|そうてい}される⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: anticipated damage
